items.title: Require complete served coverage and verify configured redirects
items.why: Missing files, arbitrary redirects and empty work can report tree-current without proving the deployed tree.
items.userOutcome: Visitors finding site information are protected by release evidence that detects absent pages and incorrect retired-route destinations.
items.acceptance: Real CLI rejects missing files, unconfigured or mismatching redirects, configured redirects answering 200, invalid concurrency and empty/incomplete coverage. Known redirects match exact status and resolved Location from the compared commit. Valid identical bytes and lane-specific lag classification remain supported. Help and malformed input perform no operational IO.

premises.claim: Empty result sets fall through to tree-current

items.recipe: Admit full argv before IO; compare each nonempty candidate once; classify missing/unexpected responses as unverified; read redirect rules from compared git tree and verify status/Location with shared parser; register real CLI fixture tests.
